title: Maximum fixed-window sum
statement_markdown: Implement `max_window_sum(values, k)`. Return the largest sum of any contiguous window of exactly `k` values.
hints: Slide by adding the entering value and subtracting the leaving value.
explanation: Maintain one running window sum rather than recomputing every range.
reference_solution:
def max_window_sum(values, k):
    current = sum(values[:k])
    best = current
    for i in range(k, len(values)):
        current += values[i] - values[i-k]
        best = max(best, current)
    return best
complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
